name: crm
description: A small business's customer record: what came in across the project, customers keyed by email, a pipeline, notes, jobs, bookings, quotes and invoices. Server-rendered on Hono, on the project's Postgres, shaped by its AI; runs in dev on its machine and in production on Cloudflare, team only.

scripts.test: tsx --import ./test/pin-config.mjs --test --test-reporter=./test/reporter.mjs test/config.test.ts test/helpers.test.ts test/db.test.ts test/sales.test.ts test/http.test.ts src/admin/test/admin-core.test.ts src/booking/test/book.test.ts src/booking/test/pages.test.ts src/booking/test/slots.test.ts src/booking/test/zones.test.ts src/booking/test/ics.test.ts src/booking/test/sync.test.ts src/booking/test/notify.test.ts src/booking/test/reminders.test.ts src/invoices/test/documents.test.ts src/invoices/test/pages.test.ts src/invoices/test/stripe.test.ts src/forms/test/fields.test.ts src/forms/test/items.test.tsx src/forms/test/cli.test.ts src/invoices/test/cli.test.ts src/data/test/cli.test.ts test/scripts.test.ts
scripts.deploy: node scripts/migrate.mjs && npm run build && python3 ~/tools/taskandtool.py deploy dist --worker build/worker.mjs --flag nodejs_compat
